subject: RESUME statement
notes: kb/Work PB1160 LANDED. A RESUME executed within a GLOBAL declarative's scope of execution (reached through the PERFORM of §14.9.49.3 SR4) is a CONTINUE: EcEmitter.EmitResume renders `if (!(__useActive[global ids])) throw new ResumeSignal(...)` in a unit that declares a GLOBAL declarative, the same per-instance test §14.9.18.4 GR6 uses. Witness covers the NEXT STATEMENT arm, the procedure-name arm (no GO TO is performed) and the contained-program arm through __RunGlobalUse. The scope is per program instance (docs/CONFORMANCE.md §3).
